title: Snow Flower and the Secret Fan
author: Lisa See
summary: In nineteenth-century rural China, two girls are bound as lifelong friends and write to each other in a secret women's script. Footbinding, marriage and class bring a painful rift.
readIf: you like intimate, emotional historical fiction about women's lives and friendship.
skipIf: you want a cheerful read or are uneasy with scenes of footbinding.
